items.title_en: Man Gets Jail Time for Using Robot Vacuum to Record Cheating Wife
items.title_zh: 男子因使用扫地机器人记录妻子出轨而被判入狱
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media recently reported the bizarre case of a scorned man who, after catching his wife cheating with another man, used the footage to sue them both for compensation. Unfortunately, that same footage was then used against him in a counter-lawsuit for recording people without their consent. The unnamed man and his wife married in 2021 and moved in with his parents. They also owned a vacation home that they only visited during the holidays.
items.summary_zh: 台湾媒体最近报道了一个离奇的案件，一名被鄙视的男子在发现自己的妻子与另一名男子外遇后，利用这段视频起诉他们两人，要求赔偿。不幸的是，同样的录像随后被用于反诉讼中，指控他在未经他人同意的情况下对他人进行录音。这名不愿透露姓名的男子和他的妻子于 2021 年结婚，并搬去与父母同住。他们还拥有一栋度假屋，只在假期期间参观。
